sections.heading: Banasthali Vidyapith vs University of Rajasthan for BEd: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Banasthali Vidyapith if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹79,000, in a private BEd setting at Jaipur.
Choose University of Rajasthan if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, in a public BEd setting at Jaipur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹79,000 as a tuition figure for B.Ed at Banasthali Vidyapith. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for University of Rajasthan that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Banasthali Vidyapith's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹9 LPA on B.Ed. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
University of Rajasthan's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on B.Ed. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Rajasthan. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Banasthali Vidyapith is listed as a private institute and University of Rajasthan as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Banasthali Vidyapith is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded BEd offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
University of Rajasthan is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded BEd offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Banasthali Vidyapith or University of Rajasthan?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Banasthali Vidyapith and University of Rajasthan differ in more than one way: one is listed as private and the other as public. Check official fees, the admission test and the latest placement report before you choose.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Banasthali Vidyapith vs University of Rajasthan?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹79,000 for Banasthali Vidyapith on B.Ed; we do not hold a quotable fee for University of Rajasthan on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Banasthali Vidyapith and University of Rajasthan?
faqs.answer: Banasthali Vidyapith's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹9 LPA on B.Ed. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Banasthali Vidyapith and University of Rajasthan accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Banasthali Vidyapith, and no listed exam on this page for University of Rajasthan. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Banasthali Vidyapith and University of Rajasthan in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
